offers_products.reason: Manufactures Zimmatic center pivot irrigation systems, FieldNET technology, and road safety products like crash cushions and barriers.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from manufactured equipment and technology; some contract manufacturing and infrastructure services are minor relative to products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are farmers/growers via dealers and road contractors and agencies, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells irrigation equipment to commercial growers through dealers, and road safety products to contractors and transportation agencies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Irrigation pivots and highway safety projects are periodic equipment and project purchases, not ongoing repeat consumables.

cyclical_demand.reason: Farmers can defer irrigation equipment purchases when crop prices fall; road project spending also varies with budgets.

big_ticket.reason: Center pivot irrigation systems are large, infrequent capital purchases for farms; infrastructure projects are also lumpy.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured equipment and technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Irrigation sells mainly to individual farmers through dealers; infrastructure sells to contractors and government agencies, a smaller part.

asset_heavy.reason: Manufacturer selling through dealers; moderate plant needs, not heavy like utilities or fleets.

notes: Irrigation is the larger segment; infrastructure is the smaller part. Asset intensity and customer size are judged from general knowledge.
